name: cosmos-sources-tools
description: Fetch and locally archive single-day or date-range source content from CLS, Knowledge Planet, DingTalk, and Feishu, with optional semantic filtering.

interface.shortDescription: Archive CLS, Knowledge Planet, DingTalk, and Feishu content by Beijing date.
interface.longDescription: Retrieves the complete China Standard Time CLS telegraph feed over the network from cls.cn, archives topics and attachments from one Knowledge Planet by operating the user's already signed-in Chrome session, or reads exact DingTalk and Feishu groups by operating the user's already signed-in desktop sessions. Every skill covers today, one historical Beijing calendar date, or one contiguous Beijing date range of at most 31 days merged into a single report, and applies an optional natural-language semantic filter (the complete unfiltered content by default); the Knowledge Planet skill additionally accepts a user-stated extraction scope, such as excluding content types (images, linked pages, PDF, HTML, Word) or keeping one version of multi-version documents. All four skills write source-grounded Markdown under source-specific Beijing-date or range directories in the fixed sources workspace `~/Documents/cosmos-workspace/sources`, which a run creates when missing; a same-identity rerun refreshes its generated file while different identities coexist. Plugin updates replace capability code only and never own user data.
defaultPrompt: Fetch the CLS telegraph feed for a Beijing date or date range, optionally filtered by topic.
Archive topics and attachments from a Knowledge Planet for one Beijing date or a date range.
Collect messages from exact DingTalk or Feishu groups for a Beijing date or range into source-faithful Markdown, with an optional filter.
